items.text: Career counselling for PCM students should do more than repeat "engineering" or "computer science" as the default answer.

It should help you weigh branch, college, and stream trade-offs honestly, take pure sciences and research seriously as real options, and choose the high-value skill path that gets you to earlier financial freedom, not just the most talked-about one.
This page is built for the Physics-Chemistry-Maths side of the Science stream, engineering, computer science, and pure-science routes.

items.text: If Biology is part of your combination instead, PCB-specific counselling covers the NEET and medical-track decisions separately.
Guidance is delivered fully online across India, so you can start from home, coaching city, or wherever you already are without waiting for local availability.

Whether entrance results go well, need a repeat attempt, or point toward a different branch than expected, PCM still opens more directions than most students are shown, the goal is a plan that works either way.
